zh.summary: 先用兩筆合成資料檢查成品，再把畫面、業務規則與交付證據連起來。你將能指出原型已做到什麼，以及下一個需要驗證的問題。
objectives: 用具體任務描述軟體成果，而非只列出畫面或工具。
區分功能展示、規格驗證、使用者驗收與正式上線。
從一次缺漏檢核追溯需求、實作、測試與交接作品。

sections.heading: 先給成品一個任務
paragraphs: 想像你是收件人員，桌上有一份虛構申請資料。你需要知道必要欄位是否齊全，並把檢查結果交給下一位同事。你打開的軟體有三個欄位：申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型。這些都是本課自訂的教學規則，不代表任何機關的正式收件規定。
先輸入編號 SYN-001、代號 DEMO-A，將文件類型留白。按下檢查後，畫面應指出缺少文件類型，且不得提供標記為完整的報告。補上文件類型「合成申請表」，再次檢查，才可以預覽並匯出完整報告。這兩筆輸入讓我們看見系統要維持的承諾。

sections.heading: 像交接一份收件檢查表
paragraphs: 把程式想成協助你檢查清單的同事：它要能說出哪一欄尚未完成，也要讓下一位接手者知道它檢查了哪些項目。如果它只說「成功」，卻沒有交代成功的是存檔、檢查還是正式受理，使用者可能採取錯誤的下一步。
本課把「完整」限定為三個必要欄位通過教學規則。它不表示內容真實、文件合法、身分已確認或業務已核准。先說清楚詞語的邊界，才能寫出可檢查的規格。

sections.heading: 從一次操作回看工程證據
paragraphs: 需求說明為什麼要檢查；介面引導人完成檢查；業務規則決定何時通過；測試留下對指定輸入的觀察；README 則讓下一位同事能重新啟動。這些作品回答不同問題，彼此可以追溯。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜沿著一個需求追溯四種證據；箭頭表示依據與驗證的先後，不代表一次完成後不再修改。

items.title: problem.md：需求
items.body: 收件人員希望在交接前知道缺少哪些必要欄位。

items.title: spec.md：承諾
items.body: 缺少文件類型時，列出缺漏，不能匯出完整報告。

items.title: app.py：實作
items.body: 表單與業務規則依同一份規格處理輸入。

items.title: tests/ 與 README：證據及交接
items.body: 保留缺漏與完整兩種結果，說明如何重現及目前限制。

sections.heading: 四個不同的完成層次
paragraphs: 功能展示表示在特定環境可以操作。規格驗證表示指定情境有證據支持，例如缺漏欄位被正確阻擋。使用者驗收還要觀察目標使用者能否理解提示並完成任務。組織正式上線則需要另外處理存取權、儲存、備份及維運等要求。
例如 AppTest 可以模擬 Streamlit 的輸入與呈現結果，但這類程式測試不會告訴你同事是否看得懂「資料完整」的意思。測試名稱與結果要說明所驗證的層次，避免用一個綠色勾勾代替所有判斷。

sections.heading: 人與 Agent 各自要交付什麼
paragraphs: 你可以請 Coding Agent 依 spec.md 建立表單、撰寫規則並執行測試。交付要求要包含可修改檔案、驗收命令及停止條件。當 Agent 發現必要欄位的定義不明時，應提出問題，由領域負責人確認；不能讓它自行發明正式收件規則。
審查時先讀需求與 Diff，再看實際結果。如果畫面很漂亮，但缺漏資料仍能匯出完整報告，就要回到規格修正。把這項差異寫成可重現的測試，比單純要求「再改善一下」更容易確認修改是否有效。

sections.heading: 常見誤解與反例
paragraphs: 「AI 寫出很多程式，所以成果很完整」無法作為驗收依據。程式碼數量沒有說明收件人員能否完成工作。反例是增加登入畫面，卻沒有任何後端授權檢查；畫面存在不代表資料已被隔離。
「只要測試都過，就可以讓十人共用」也需要補充條件。若測試只涵蓋本機單人資料檢核，它沒有驗證多人資料隔離。下一步應先畫出共用時的資料流與信任邊界，重新確認需求。C4 的 Context 與 Container 圖可協助描述這些不同層次的系統關係。

exercise.environment: 紙筆或本機文字編輯器；只用下列合成資料，不需安裝 Agent。
steps: 建立一份成品觀察紀錄，列出 SYN-001、DEMO-A、文件類型空白的預期結果。
再列出三欄皆有值的預期結果，明寫「完整」的教學定義。
將每項預期分別連到 problem.md、spec.md、app.py 或 tests/，指出你目前實際擁有哪些證據。
exercise.expected: 得到兩個輸入情境、一個明確的完整性定義，以及作品與證據對照。
exercise.check: 請同儕讀你的紀錄：他能否在不猜測的情況下說出缺漏時能不能匯出完整報告？若不能，補寫規則。
exercise.cleanup: 保留合成紀錄供 M03 使用；不要填入真實收件資料。

readingGuide.goal: 用具體任務描述軟體成果，而非只列出畫面或工具。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 紙筆或本機文字編輯器；只用下列合成資料，不需安裝 Agent。
readingGuide.route: 先讀原理與例子，再完成最小實作，最後核對理解檢核與參考解析。
readingGuide.output: 得到兩個輸入情境、一個明確的完整性定義，以及作品與證據對照。

en.summary: Check a product with two synthetic inputs, then connect its interface, business rules and delivery evidence. Identify what the prototype already does and the next question that needs verification.
objectives: Describe a software outcome through a concrete task, beyond a list of screens or tools.
Distinguish feature demonstrations, specification verification, user acceptance and production release.
Trace one missing-data check through requirements, implementation, tests and handoff artifacts.

sections.heading: Give the Product a Task First
paragraphs: Imagine you work at an intake desk with a fictional application. You need to check that required fields are present and hand the result to a colleague. The software has three fields: application ID, applicant code and document type. These are teaching rules defined for this course, not official intake rules for any organization.

Enter SYN-001 as the ID and DEMO-A as the code, leaving document type blank. After checking, the interface should identify the missing document type and offer no report marked complete. Enter “合成申請表” (synthetic application form) as the document type and check again; only then should a complete report be available for preview and export. These two inputs expose the promise the system must keep.

sections.heading: Like Handing Over an Intake Checklist
paragraphs: Think of the program as a colleague helping with a checklist. It needs to identify unfinished fields and tell the next person what it checked. A message that only says “success” leaves the user guessing whether saving, checking or official acceptance succeeded, which can lead to the wrong next action.

In this course, “complete” means only that three required fields passed the teaching rules. It does not establish truth, legal validity, verified identity or business approval. Define that boundary before writing a specification that can be checked.

sections.heading: Trace One Action Back to Engineering Evidence
paragraphs: Requirements explain why a check is needed; the interface helps someone perform it; business rules decide when it passes; tests record observations for specified inputs; and the README lets the next colleague start the application again. These artifacts answer different questions and can be traced to one another.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Trace one requirement through four kinds of evidence. Arrows show the order of justification and verification, not a one-time process with no later revisions.
blocks.description: Read the numbered steps in order.

items.title: problem.md: the need
items.body: Intake staff need to know which required fields are missing before handoff.

items.title: spec.md: the promise
items.body: When document type is missing, list the omission and prevent complete-report export.

items.title: app.py: the implementation
items.body: The form and business rules process input according to the same specification.

items.title: tests/ and README: evidence and handoff
items.body: Retain incomplete and complete results, reproduction instructions and current limits.

sections.heading: Four Different Levels of Completion
paragraphs: A feature demonstration shows that the application can be operated in a particular environment. Specification verification provides evidence for stated scenarios, such as correctly blocking missing fields. User acceptance also requires observing whether target users understand the feedback and complete their task. Production release adds requirements such as access permissions, storage, backups and operations.

For example, AppTest can simulate Streamlit input and inspect displayed results, but a programmatic test does not tell you whether a colleague understands “data complete.” Name tests and results according to the level they verify, so that one green check does not stand in for every decision.

sections.heading: What People and Agents Must Deliver
paragraphs: You can ask a Coding Agent to build a form, write rules and run tests according to spec.md. State which files it may change, the acceptance commands and the stop conditions. If the definition of a required field is unclear, the agent should ask the domain owner to decide; it must not invent official intake rules.

Review the requirement and diff, then inspect actual results. If the interface looks polished but incomplete data still produces a complete report, return to the specification and correct the behavior. Recording the discrepancy as a reproducible test makes the effect of a change easier to verify than a request to “improve it again.”

sections.heading: Common Misunderstandings and Counterexamples
paragraphs: “The AI wrote a lot of code, so the product is complete” is not an acceptance criterion. Code volume does not tell you whether intake staff can do their work. Consider a login screen with no server-side authorization checks: the screen alone does not establish data isolation.

“All tests pass, so ten people can share it” also needs conditions. Tests limited to local single-user completeness checking do not verify shared-user data isolation. First map the shared system’s data flows and trust boundaries, and revisit requirements. C4 Context and Container diagrams help describe system relationships at these different levels.

exercise.environment: Paper or a local text editor. Use only the synthetic data below; no agent installation is needed.
steps: Create a product observation record with the expected result for SYN-001, DEMO-A and a blank document type.
Record the expected result when all three fields have values, explicitly defining “complete” for this exercise.
Link each expectation to problem.md, spec.md, app.py or tests/, and state which evidence you actually have.
exercise.expected: Two input scenarios, an explicit completeness definition, and a mapping of artifacts to evidence.
exercise.check: Ask a peer to read the record: can they tell, without guessing, whether incomplete input may produce a complete report? If not, add the missing rule.
exercise.cleanup: Keep the synthetic record for M03. Do not enter real intake data.

readingGuide.goal: Describe a software outcome through a concrete task, beyond a list of screens or tools.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Paper or a local text editor. Use only the synthetic data below; no agent installation is needed.
readingGuide.route: Read the principles and examples, complete the small exercise, then compare your reasoning with the checks and reference explanations.
readingGuide.output: Two input scenarios, an explicit completeness definition, and a mapping of artifacts to evidence.

zh.prompt: 你看到原型能在本機啟動，應如何描述目前成果？
options: 系統已可正式供十人共用
特定環境可啟動；仍需按規格與使用者任務驗證
只要頁面沒有錯字就完成驗收
rationales: 本機啟動沒有證明多人授權、儲存及維運需求。
這個說法精確對應已觀察到的啟動結果，並指出下一道驗證。
人仍需確認規則、審查修改及判讀證據。
文字校對是品質的一部分，不能代替功能或任務驗收。

en.prompt: The prototype starts locally. How should you describe the result?
options: The system is ready for ten people to share in production.
It starts in a particular environment; specification and user-task verification are still needed.
The AI has completed all engineering responsibilities.
Acceptance is complete if the page has no typos.
rationales: Local startup does not establish shared-user authorization, storage or operations requirements.
This statement matches the observed startup result and identifies the next verification step.
People still need to confirm rules, review changes and interpret evidence.
Copyediting contributes to quality but cannot replace functional or task acceptance.
